recentItems.title: Trials of Maya: The Tabletop Game - Official Trailer | Anand Gandhi & Zain Memon
recentItems.description:
Take a look at the Gamefound launch trailer for Trials of MAYA, the upcoming tabletop game from Anand Gandhi and Zain Memon, set within the expansive MAYA Narrative Universe. Command Maya’s greatest legends as you topple towers, hunt minions, and combo your way to victory. Trials of MAYA is an expandable, card-driven tactical arena game that is also part of the larger MAYA universe, which is set to expand into video games, making this the next major step in the franchise’s evolution across formats. Trials of MAYA Gamefound campaign launches on September 8, 2026.

recentItems.title: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls - Official Champion Character Guide
recentItems.description:
After destroying entire worlds, the Champion is ready to jump into your team! Check out his character guide and learn everything you need to know to obliterate your opponents! Control his aggressive and powerful toolkit, featuring throws, devastating blows, lunging attacks, and shockwaves, which will become a relentless force to dominate each battle.
Marvel Tokon Fighting Souls is out now for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and PC (Steam).

recentItems.title: Onimusha Shows Why Capcom Is on a Winning Streak
recentItems.description:
There are very few publishers who can claim to have had quite as prosperous a decade as Capcom. The company’s 10 best-selling games all launched within the past 10 years, a chain of good fortune that began with 2017’s Resident Evil 7. Capcom’s reimagining of gaming’s most important survival horror series became something of a formula for its wider success, and that template can be seen in action once again with this year’s Onimusha: Way of the Sword. 

Onimusha: Way of the Sword succeeds because it does what Capcom games like Resident Evil 7 and Monster Hunter: World did before it - combine the best of the series' past with the best of the wider industry to create a brilliant modern formula.

#IGN #Onimusha #Capcom

recentItems.title: Valheim - Official (Y)our Journey Developer Behind-The-Scenes
recentItems.description:
As Valheim’s 1.0 launch approaches, we look back at what was and towards the future at what will be. Thank you for embarking on this magical journey with us - a journey that’s yours, as much as ours. 
Before journeying to the snowy biome, take a look back at the adventure. Join the team at Iron Gate for a behind-the-scenes look at the development of Valheim over the years in this new video for the open-world survival-crafting action-adventure game. The new video also features community members sharing their experiences playing. Finally, get a new look at the Deep North biome coming to version 1.0 of Valheim. Valheim is available now on Steam, Windows PC, Xbox, Humble, and Mac App stores. Version 1.0 of Valheim and the Deep North update will be available on Steam, Windows PC, Xbox Series X/S, Xbox One, Humble, Mac App stores, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Nintendo Switch 2 on September 9, 2026.

recentItems.title: 2XKO - Official Lux Champion Spotlight Trailer
recentItems.description:
Check out the latest Champion Spotlight for Riots 2v2 tag fighter 2XKO. Lux is a tricky hybrid zoner and rushdown fighter. She can overwhelm opponents with her superior speed and unique airdash to bait opponents into making a mistake and leaving themselves open to big damage. She can also control the screen space with her plethora of projectiles, pushing an opponent into the corner to break through their defence with her setup tools. 

Lux joins the 2XKO roster on September 8th for PlayStation 5 (PS5), PC, and Xbox Series X|S.

recentItems.title: Why Brutality is the Key to Making the Ultimate Wolverine Game
recentItems.description:
There is rage in Wolverine. Violence isn’t just something he’s capable of; it’s an intrinsic part of him that he cannot live without. This is the guy who tore Hulk open from the inside, and that kind of untamed brutality is what a great Wolverine game needs—it must explore his extreme relationship with extreme violence.

This is why brutality is the key to making the ultimate Wolverine game.

#ign #gaming

recentItems.title: Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown - Official Q Trials Announcement Trailer
recentItems.description:
You got the U.S.S. Voyager home once, yet Q isn’t fully impressed and offers you even more challenges. Watch the latest Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown trailer to see what to expect with the Q Trials, a new roguelike game mode that lets Q do what he does best: mess with the rules. Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown's Q: Trials and the Equinox DLC will be available on PC, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X|S on October 1, 2026.

The new trailer, featuring John de Lancie (who plays Q), showcases the Q Trials roguelike mode, which makes life in the Delta Quadrant more demanding with randomized events, changing routes and challenges, while giving more freedom in how you build your crew and turns each journey through the Delta Quadrant into a different test. 

In addition to the free update, the Equinox DLC also launches, adding the U.S.S. Equinox as a playable ship for Q Trials, together with Captain Rudolph Ransom, Maxwell Burke, and Noah Lessing.

recentItems.title: What's the deal with the latest Riftbound set? #PAXWest
You Can See Everything - Official Teaser (2026) Nathan Fielder, Elizabeth Holmes
recentItems.description:
Don't miss this trailer for You Can See Everything, an upcoming documentary from A24, directed by Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim. You Can See Everything is the true events of notorious Silicone Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes, 34 days before she's sent to prison, she invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. This is what they captured. 

You Can See Everything comes to cinemas this October!
